sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AMPLIFIED FLOW REGIME WILL CONTINUE ON THURSDAY WITH UPPER TROUGHS ACROSS THE PACIFIC NW AND THE NERN STATES WITH A RIDGE ACROSS THE MS RIVER VALLEY. MEANWHILE...REMNANT ALEX WILL CONTINUE WWD INTO NRN MEXICO. IN THE LOWER LEVELS...A FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO SETTLE SWD THROUGH THE SRN STATES WITH THE TAIL-END REDEVELOPING NWD AS A WARM FRONT IN THE SRN PLAINS. MEANWHILE...A WEAK FRONT DRAPED NE-SW ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS WILL REMAIN IN PLACE AS THE PRIMARY SYNOPTIC FRONT STRENGTHENS OVER THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST BY THE END OF THE PERIOD.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: THERE WILL BE LITTLE CHANGE TO THE OVERALL SEVERE SCENARIO ON THURSDAY. AIR MASS SHOULD RECOVER FROM NOCTURNAL STORMS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WITH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE SURGING W TO THE CONTINENTAL DIVIDE. BY AFTERNOON...MLCAPES SHOULD RANGE FROM 1000-1500 J/KG ALONG THE DIVIDE TO OVER 2000 J/KG ALONG THE MT/ND BORDER. WHILE ERN PARTS OF THE SLIGHT RISK MAY EXPERIENCE DELAYED HEATING...HIGH TERRAIN STORMS ARE EXPECTED BY MID-AFTERNOON OVER NE ID AND SW MT WHERE WEAK IMPULSES EJECTING DOWNSTREAM ENHANCE THE DIURNAL CYCLE. ROUGHLY 45-50 KTS OF VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR MATURING SUPERCELLS TO ROOT INTO THE STRONGER INSTABILITY ALONG THE HIGH PLAINS WITH LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. EXPECT ACTIVITY WILL CONTINUE TO GROW UPSCALE INTO DAMAGING WIND BOWS/LEWPS AS STORMS CONTINUE ENE INTO ERN MT AND WRN ND DURING THE EVENING/NIGHT.

sections.title: S TX
sections.text: BANDS OF CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO ROTATE CYCLONICALLY ACROSS S TX AROUND REMNANT ALEX DURING THURSDAY. BELT OF 45-50 KTS OF LOW-LEVEL EASTERLIES ALONG THE NRN PERIPHERY OF THE DECAYING STORM WILL AUGMENT LOW-LEVEL HELICITY THROUGH MOST OF THE DAY. HIGH-RESOLUTION NMM MODEL SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW ROTATING STORMS WITH ATTENDANT TORNADO RISKS. THE SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD WANE AFTER DARK. ..RACY/ROGERS.. 07/01/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER S TX...

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: TSTMS ARE ONGOING THIS MORNING ACROSS PARTS OF SWRN/S-CNTRL MT IN CONJUNCTION WITH A LOW-AMPLITUDE IMPULSE LIFTING NEWD THROUGH THE SNAKE RIVER VALLEY. THIS ACTIVITY MAY CONTINUE THROUGH THE MORNING ACROSS CNTRL/ERN PARTS OF MT...THOUGH LIMITED INSTABILITY SHOULD PROHIBIT AN ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. IN THE WAKE OF THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY...DECREASING CLOUDINESS AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL COMBINE WITH A RELATIVELY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER TO ONCE AGAIN SUPPORT MODERATE AFTERNOON INSTABILITY. EXPECT MLCAPE TO RANGE FROM 1000-1500 J/KG ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF WRN MT TO 2000-2500 J/KG ACROSS ERN MT AND ND. MORE VIGOROUS...DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED THIS AFTERNOON OVER WRN/CNTRL MT AS FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH UPSTREAM SHORT-WAVE TROUGH /NOW TRANSLATING NEWD THROUGH CNTRL/ERN WA/ORE/ OVERSPREADS WRN EXTENSION OF INSTABILITY AXIS. SIMILAR TO PREVIOUS DAYS...KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT WILL FEATURE 40-55 KT OF DEEP SWLY SHEAR...SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED TSTMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS WITH THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. WITH TIME...STORMS MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO A BOWING/MESOSCALE SYSTEM WITH THE THREAT FOR MAINLY DAMAGING WINDS

sections.title: S TX
sections.text: LOW-LEVEL MASS FIELD ASSOCIATED WITH ALEX WILL CONTINUE TO FAVOR CONFLUENT BANDS OF TSTMS WITHIN A VERY MOIST AIR MASS WITH PW VALUES OF 2.50-2.80 INCHES. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL TEND TO DECREASE WITH TIME OWING TO FRICTIONAL EFFECTS. HOWEVER...INCREASED DIABATIC HEATING AND RESULTANT STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES --AND INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY-- WILL OFFSET THE WEAKENING SHEAR WITH ENVIRONMENT REMAINING SUPPORTIVE OF EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF A FEW TORNADOES THROUGH THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE. ..MEAD/HURLBUT.. 07/01/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS TODAY ACROSS S TX
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT FROM S CENTRAL MT ENEWD INTO WRN/NRN ND...

sections.title: MT/ND AREA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: SIMILAR TO YESTERDAY...A MIDLEVEL TROUGH REMAINS ANCHORED OVER THE PAC NW...WITH A BELT OF 50-80 KT SWLY MID-UPPER FLOW EXTENDING ACROSS ID/MT ALONG A LOW-MIDLEVEL BAROCLINIC ZONE. SOME MORNING CONVECTION AND CLOUDS ACROSS S CENTRAL/CENTRAL MT ARE EXPECTED TO CLEAR BY MIDDAY...WITH SUBSTANTIAL SURFACE HEATING IN THE WAKE OF THESE CLOUDS. GIVEN MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 8 C/KM AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 50S...AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG ARE EXPECTED. ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR BY 20-21Z OVER THE HIGH TERRAIN IN SW/S CENTRAL MT. INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AOA 40 KT WILL AGAIN SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. THOUGH NOT EXPECTED TO BE A PRIMARY THREAT...BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND HODOGRAPH CURVATURE IN THE LOW LEVELS MAY ALSO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A SUPERCELL TORNADO OR TWO THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING AS STORMS MOVE INTO S CENTRAL/CENTRAL MT. LATER DURING THE EVENING...STORM MERGERS AND COLD POOL INTERACTIONS COULD LEAD TO SOME UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS WITH A GREATER THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AS STORMS SPREAD NEWD ACROSS MT TOWARD WRN ND. OTHER MORE

sections.title: S TX TODAY
sections.text: WEAKENING TC ALEX IS MOVING INLAND OVER MEXICO NEAR 23 N AND 100 W AS OF 16Z. RICH MOISTURE AND A BELT OF 30-40 KT LOW-MIDLEVEL ESELY FLOW EXTENDS AS FAR N AS S TX...WHERE REMNANT OUTER CONVECTIVE BANDS ARE STILL ONGOING. A FEW SEMI-DISCRETE ROTATING STORMS AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES WILL STILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH THE DAY WITHIN THESE BANDS BEFORE VERTICAL SHEAR WEAKENS LATE TODAY INTO TONIGHT. ..THOMPSON/DEAN.. 07/01/2010

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS S TX
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT FROM SWRN/CENTRAL MT INTO NWRN/NRN ND... NO CHANGES ARE REQUIRED WITH THE ISSUANCE OF THIS CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK...GIVEN THAT THE LATE MORNING FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK FOR THE TWO PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT AREAS TODAY /NRN ROCKIES TO NRN PLAINS AND S TX/. SHORT TERM MESOSCALE DETAILS FOR EACH OF THESE REGIONS ARE AVAILABLE IN SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS 1176 FOR NRN ROCKIES TO CENTRAL MT AND 1177 FOR TORNADO WATCH 435 ACROSS S TX. IN THE SOUTHEAST STATES...A COLD FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO SETTLE SWD ACROSS SRN SC AND THROUGH MUCH OF GA/AL THIS FORECAST PERIOD. TSTM CHANCES...THOUGH ALREADY LOW...WILL CONTINUE TO DIMINISH FROM N-S WITH THE PASSAGE OF THE FRONT...AND THUS THE GENERAL TSTM LINE FROM NRN AL TO THE SRN NC COAST HAS BEEN SHIFTED SWD. ..PETERS.. 07/01/2010 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1115 AM CDT THU JUL 01 2010/
